items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: with Teddy Wilson, with Red Norvo, with Mildred Bailey, any number of dates.

ctx.x: Buffalo and so Stuff asked me would I like to join the band, so I said yes, and then's when I joined the band, out of Willie Bryant's band, I would join Stuff at the Onyx Club on 52nd Street. There I stayed, oh goodness, I was with Stuff quite a while till I joined Cab Calloway. And then oh goodness, all during that time that I was with Stuff, is when I started to do records with everybody, you know like with Bunny Berigan, Dick McDonna and Carl Kriss..
Mildred Bailey, Red Norvo, Joe Marsella, oh yeah, Red Norvo, Lionel, Ella, of course Sarah, Sarah Vaughn, the Andrews Sisters, yeah, I did a lot of recordings.
